title: The Tuft Quarto example does not compile on the Posit Cloud
description:
I wanted to use the Tuft Quarto example on the Posit Cloud ([the qmd and the bib file here](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-gallery/tree/main/page-layout), but it does not compile. I get a tikz-related error message: 
```
ERROR: 
compilation failed- no matching packages
Package tikz Error: Sorry, some package has redefined the meaning of the math
-mode dollar sign. This is incompatible with tikz and its calc library and might cause unrecoverable errors.
```
I can compile the tuft qmd to a pdf locally, I don't get any errors then. I do have the full TeX distribution on my computer that I updated recently, so maybe that makes a difference. 

**UPDATE**:  Uninstalling and reinstalling **tinytex** on the Posit Cloud did the trick, and the tuft.qmd compiled to a pdf.
